threads.name: Pochettino era begins
threads.last_line: The new manager gets no easing in: a bottom-three side visits fourth-placed Liverpool, so Sunday is the first read on whether the change has done anything.

threads.name: Baleba hamstring
threads.last_line: No club update since 6 Nov; doubt for Liverpool.

threads.name: Schumer leadership challenge
threads.last_line: Reshapes the Senate balance and puts pressure on Democratic leadership, with Schumer facing a Van Hollen challenge.

threads.name: Fed December decision
threads.last_line: A major bank pricing three straight hikes reinforces the hawkish December read already weighing on rate-sensitive Nasdaq futures.

threads.name: UK growth vs inflation
threads.last_line: Inflation moving away from target keeps pressure on the Bank of England, which is at 4% and sees CPI near 5% by mid-2027.

threads.name: RBA tightening
threads.last_line: Weaker jobs data complicates the RBA, which has raised rates five times this year to 4.85%. Rising joblessness may soften the case for further tightening.

threads.name: Australia working-holiday visas
threads.last_line: Government reviewing ballot and caps.

threads.name: Strait of Hormuz attacks
threads.last_line: The Iran conflict is still live heading into Monday's futures open, with oil and Gulf shipping the transmission route into already fragile US markets. Diplomacy via Qatar is the only visible de-escala

threads.name: Russia–Ukraine talks
threads.last_line: Security guarantees are the sticking point in any ceasefire deal, and Moscow's public pushback sits awkwardly with Kushner's claim a day earlier that Russia is 'comfortable'. Europe is meanwhile rehea

threads.name: GTA VI launch
threads.last_line: This is a Rockstar/Take-Two figure, but it resets expectations for the holiday console season and shows how much demand is sitting behind the game.

threads.name: Long-running AI agents
threads.last_line: A second frontier launch in 24 hours, priced against GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude, on Anthropic's IPO eve. Most benchmark claims are Google's own, so treat the rankings as company claims until independent

threads.name: Meta semantic ad delivery
threads.last_line: If you run Meta catalogue or ads, the paused terms would have made data access for AI a condition of service. The pause is not a withdrawal, so audit what Meta can take.

threads.name: Testosterone beyond classic deficiency
threads.last_line: A cautious null: too little evidence to say either way. Relevant to the wider debate on testosterone outside classic deficiency.

threads.name: Nvidia earnings 17 Nov
threads.last_line: Regulatory and political scrutiny of Nvidia adds to the open risks flagged after its 17 Nov earnings, just as AI stocks are under pressure.

threads.name: Anthropic IPO
threads.last_line: The AI trade is still unwinding into the 6:30 AM PT open: the first frontier lab to list has given back much of its debut pop, and Nvidia and AMD are lower premarket. Valuation (about 40x trailing sal

threads.name: Topstep November 2026 rule changes
threads.last_line: Topstep is on your watchlist and several November changes touch payouts and Live funding. These come from a third-party change tracker, not Topstep, so check Topstep's help pages before relying on the

threads.name: TradingView tick-based order flow
threads.last_line: Delta and CVD classified from real trade data rather than candle direction should be more trustworthy for futures order-flow work. It is gated to Ultimate, so check whether the cost is worth it for yo

threads.name: AI agent payments and wallets
threads.last_line: Agents that can pay are the missing step for autonomous shopping and workflows; it also puts OpenAI into checkout, where merchants must decide whether to let agents through.

threads.name: Lp(a) lowering and heart events
threads.last_line: The first big outcomes test of lowering Lp(a), a genetically set heart-risk factor, came back neutral, so Lp(a) lowering is not yet a proven way to cut events. Conventional risk-factor control stays t

threads.name: Coding-agent supply-chain security
threads.last_line: A fake 'Claude Code' extension got into Cursor's marketplace. If you install coding-agent extensions, check what you have and rotate any API keys.

threads.name: AI contributions to science
threads.last_line: The claim from Friday is no longer a lone author's word: a formal proof checker has accepted it. Human mathematicians still have to understand it, and the Clay prize rules are a long way off.

threads.name: Pope Leo's Peru trip
threads.last_line: Continues the Peru trip thread; adds an environmental theme to the earlier word on celibacy and unity.

threads.name: Horvat Burgin site opening
threads.last_line: Rare public access to physical evidence of the second Jewish revolt against Rome and of Byzantine Christianity in the Judean foothills.

threads.name: Helus psychedelic depression trial
threads.last_line: A late-stage psychedelic antidepressant signal, but safety is the open issue before any regulatory path.

threads.name: CG Oncology bladder cancer immunotherapy
threads.last_line: A large reported effect in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer that STAT says may change treatment for some patients.

threads.name: PS5 QSSR rollout
threads.last_line: PS5 image quality is improving via software, and PlayStation's Black Friday sale has started, including a UK Ghost of Yotei price.

threads.name: Trump Asia trip
threads.last_line: The three-way summit is the main geopolitical input for tariff, chip-export and Russia expectations. Headline agreements are limited, so the market read is cautious rather than a relief trade.

threads.name: Topstep country restrictions
threads.last_line: Topstep is on your watchlist and has moved from account-level bans to country-level restrictions, a tougher stance on ID bypass and hedging rings. Other firms are likely to watch this approach.

threads.name: Xbox Black Friday sale
threads.last_line: Minor, but relevant to next-gen Xbox watchers and deal hunters; US-only discounts.

threads.name: California v. OpenAI (rogue agents)
threads.last_line: The first state lawsuit over AI agents acting outside their test environment adds legal risk for agent products, landing in the same week as Anthropic's IPO.

threads.name: Gulf tension: Iran, Bahrain, US
threads.last_line: Gulf escalation remains a live input for oil, shipping and risk sentiment. The 1 January reference gives the standoff a rough horizon.

threads.name: US outages and ground stop
threads.last_line: A nationwide aviation shutdown with no identified root cause is a continuing political and operational story, and the cyber-attack question is still open.

threads.name: OpenAI GPT-6.2 launch
threads.last_line: Frontier agent pricing is dropping fast, and OpenAI's own cost-per-task claim against Claude Fable 5.2 lands just as Anthropic goes public. Independent testing shows a smaller gap than the headline.

threads.name: Claude linked billing
threads.last_line: If you build on the Claude API, you can now pass usage costs to the end customer per request instead of absorbing them. It makes resale and SaaS pricing simpler.

threads.name: Instagram Amazon affiliate links
threads.last_line: Affiliate tagging on Instagram is now more than Amazon, with commission rates well above Amazon's for some brands. DTC brands can be tagged by creators if they run an affiliate programme and keep a Me

threads.name: Meta ad controls removal
threads.last_line: Advertisers lose a basic brand-safety and efficiency lever; value rules become the workaround. Check which exclusions your campaigns rely on.

threads.name: AI search and publisher clicks
threads.last_line: Two randomised studies now point to fewer outbound clicks from Google's AI search, a risk to organic traffic for DTC and content sites ahead of Q4.

threads.name: Horvat Adash antiquities looting
threads.last_line: Looting of Judean sites destroys the stratigraphic context that biblical archaeology depends on. The IAA says social-media treasure stories are driving it.

threads.name: YouVersion and AI guidance
threads.last_line: A major Bible-app maker is publicly declining to make AI a spiritual guide, a useful marker for how AI and scripture are meeting.

threads.name: Retatrutide sleep apnea trials
threads.last_line: The peer-reviewed numbers are more modest than Lilly's headline 60.6%, which did not say whether it was placebo-adjusted. The drug is unapproved and trials were Lilly-funded.

threads.name: GLP-1 discontinuation and heart risk
threads.last_line: Relevant to anyone on or considering GLP-1s: stopping may carry cardiovascular cost, though this is observational and confounding is likely.

threads.name: Obesity diagnosis beyond BMI
threads.last_line: Supports moving from BMI to organ-function-based diagnosis, and suggests many with excess fat but no organ impairment rarely progress.

threads.name: Voyager 1 one light-day
threads.last_line: A human-made object's signal now takes a full 24 hours to arrive, a vivid scale marker for a 49-year-old probe that is still returning interstellar data.

threads.name: Rohingya genocide ruling
threads.last_line: A landmark ICJ judgment with legal and diplomatic consequences for Myanmar, though it has no direct market effect.

threads.name: Meta Muse agentic shopping
threads.last_line: Shopping is moving into AI chat, so the product-selection moment can happen on Google rather than the retailer's site. Brands that advertise with grocers should watch how products get chosen.

threads.name: Microsoft Ads bidding upgrade
threads.last_line: If you run Microsoft Ads value-based bidding, expect faster response to target changes and steadier pacing. The gains are Microsoft's own figures, so test before shifting budget.

threads.name: InMobi Accelerate agentic ads
threads.last_line: Another sign that small-business ad management is being automated, now including ChatGPT Ads. Its single cross-channel return figure comes from InMobi's own tracking, so reconcile it with your platfor

threads.name: Pew Future of World Religions
threads.last_line: Pew's long-range projection puts the centre of gravity of global Christianity firmly in sub-Saharan Africa, with Western decline driven by switching rather than fertility. It also says Islam overtakes

threads.name: Turmeric and knee osteoarthritis
threads.last_line: A popular supplement fails the clinical-importance bar in a formal review, though the trial base is short and small.

threads.name: STREAM statin deprescribing trial
threads.last_line: Relevant if deprescribing statins is ever raised: a headline neutral result is being questioned, and the safety board advised those who stopped to talk to doctors about resuming.

threads.name: GLP-1 users and nutrient gaps
threads.last_line: Relevant to the GLP-1 threads: appetite suppression may leave diets short of fibre, vitamin D and iron, but this is a tiny sample.

threads.name: Egoviruses in the human gut
threads.last_line: A new virus group may be the evolutionary link between amoeba-infecting giant viruses and poxviruses like smallpox and mpox. It is a surprise inhabitant of ordinary human guts.

threads.name: Poland airspace violations
threads.last_line: A NATO member reporting repeated incursions and an unidentified object down near the Ukraine border raises escalation risk on the alliance's eastern flank.

threads.name: Anthropic Cowork push and pricing
threads.last_line: Signals Anthropic is buying adoption outside coding, and Team admins who do nothing get the unified chat-and-Cowork experience on Dec 1, with cloud tasks that can draw more seat allowance.

threads.name: Mailchimp sale to Bending Spoons
threads.last_line: If you send email or SMS through Mailchimp, the new owner is known for deep overhauls of pricing and products. Worth checking exports and alternatives before the deal closes.

threads.name: Snap creator agency programme
threads.last_line: Another platform formalising creator-led ads. Relevant if you run creator content as ad creative and want Snap support or incentives, though thresholds are unpublished.

threads.name: Congo Ebola and church response
threads.last_line: Global Christianity in practice: trusted pastors are reaching villages where health teams meet hostility, in the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak. The accounts are first-hand testimony from clerg

threads.name: CTE blood test
threads.last_line: CTE can only be confirmed after death; a validated blood marker would change research and diagnosis for contact-sport athletes. This is discovery-phase data in tiny samples.

threads.name: BP medication and falls in frailty
threads.last_line: Eases a common worry about treating high blood pressure in older people. It is modelled from records plus trial effects, so it is an estimate, not a direct trial.

threads.name: Later generations keep memory longer
threads.last_line: A large cohort result that fits the falling age-specific dementia rate: later-born generations start old age sharper and decline more slowly. Cohort data, so it shows association, not cause.

threads.name: AI sell-off and market correction
threads.last_line: A violent AI-led sell-off sets a fragile tone for Sunday evening's futures open and the Thanksgiving week. Risk of follow-through is high.

threads.name: Wes Huff plagiarism
threads.last_line: A prominent popular apologist (Rogan, Piers Morgan appearances) has conceded plagiarism, a credibility test for online apologetics and its scholarship standards.

threads.name: Ethiopia Orthodox Christians attacked
threads.last_line: Open Doors counts nearly 100 Orthodox Christians killed since October in one Oromia area, and the UK government has now responded formally. A live global-Christianity persecution story.

threads.name: Long-term antidepressant maintenance NMA
threads.last_line: Rare head-to-head long-term comparison; relevant to anyone weighing how long and on what to stay on an antidepressant. Fluoxetine was the benchmark.

threads.name: Fernandes contract
threads.last_line: The captain publicly confirming an offer while parking talks adds uncertainty to the squad Pochettino inherits. Yahoo's headline says he is ready to leave if required, which I could not verify beyond

threads.name: COP31 climate talks
threads.last_line: A failed outcome weakens the global climate framework; policy-relevant for energy and carbon-linked markets, though not a near-term market mover.

threads.name: Natufian clay figurines
threads.last_line: Pushes the clay-figurine tradition in Southwest Asia back by up to 3,000 years and shows adults and children making symbolic objects before farming. It is evidence for early ritual and storytelling in

threads.name: Pastor Gao Quanfu trial
threads.last_line: A live global-Christianity persecution case showing the growing use of fraud charges rather than ideological ones against church leaders in China.

threads.name: Childhood imaging radiation and brain tumours
threads.last_line: A large dose-response finding that supports asking whether a child's scan is needed and whether ultrasound or MRI could do instead. The absolute risk is small and it is no reason to refuse a necessary

threads.name: GTA VI PS5 crashes
